# SnapShots

> WordPress plugin for named development snapshots of the database and uploads.

SnapShots saves and restores site state on the same server via the admin bar or `wp snapshot` WP-CLI commands. It is for local and development sites, not off-site production backup.

## Docs

- Landing page: https://snapshots.everpress.co/
- Human guide: https://snapshots.everpress.co/guide.html
- Agent guide (WP-CLI workflow): https://snapshots.everpress.co/agents.md
- Source repository: https://github.com/everpress-co/snapshots
- WordPress.org plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/snapshots/

## Agent quick reference

When SnapShots is installed on a dev site (WP-CLI shell, or WordPress 6.9+ Abilities API with `manage_options`):

1. List: `wp snapshot list --format=json` or ability `snapshots/list`
2. Backup: `wp snapshot backup "Before <task>" --files` or ability `snapshots/backup` before risky changes
3. Restore: `wp snapshot restore <file-id>` or ability `snapshots/restore` only for your task snapshot or when the user asks. Use the exact `file` id from list, not a shortened slug or the display name.
4. Do not delete (`wp snapshot delete` / ability `snapshots/delete`) unless the user asks

Abilities: `snapshots/list`, `snapshots/backup`, `snapshots/restore`, `snapshots/delete`. See agents.md for restore side effects and requirements.
